name: Prompt Injection
execute: Submit a clean legitimate task, then introduce the conflicting instruction in the intended direct or lower-trust channel.
interpret: Observe a higher-priority instruction conflict; text echoed from a document alone is not proof of bypass.
remediate: Examine prompt boundaries, data provenance, and application-side enforcement.
source: OWASP AI Testing Guide v1.0 (November 2025); summarised editorially.

name: Sensitive Data Leak
execute: Seed a known, non-sensitive canary accessible only in one security context; test isolation with a second context.
interpret: Treat only the exact controlled canary or verified protected data crossing the boundary as disclosure.
remediate: Apply access checks, tenant isolation, redaction and retention controls.
source: OWASP AI Testing Guide v1.0 (November 2025); summarised editorially.

name: Unsafe Outputs

name: Agentic Behavior Limits

name: Embedding Manipulation
